items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: there was a little guy by the name of Sam Amato that I knew up there

ctx.x: Well, that was a band that included Clarke Terry and Jimmy Nottingham and Doc Severinsen, Joe Graves, and let's see -- oh, Dick Shanahan. That was a rather interesting period. That was the band that we finished this "Song Is Born" thing, and I finally got with the band. We had already gotten Clarke from -- what's his name, Hudson's band in St. Louis. Charlie Shavers put me onto him. And Clarke was in the band. Then we got Jimmy Nottingham. I

stole Jimmy from Lionel Hampton. Nice business, isn't it, stealing. That's a terrible -- but we had open -- I finally got with the band up in Portland there, and there was a little guy by the name of Sam Amato that I knew up there, a local musician, also in the produce business, and he said, "Hey, I've got a guy here you've got to hear." Well, sitting in on the job, nine times out of ten it's a disaster, you know. But this night it happened to be raining, and the people were leaving early and I said, "All right,…
